name: AI Official Account Radar
tagline: English alerts when AI labs ship models, credits or price changes
description: Follows what the big AI labs and coding-agent teams post on their own accounts so you do not have to. A written recap lands twice a day as well, so the day's product news arrives in one readable pass.
